stem: A team reports "revenue per visitor = €70" for a landing page. They averaged revenue over the 50 visitors who bought, out of 2,000 visitors in all. Each buyer placed one order. What did they actually compute?

options.text: Revenue per visitor, correctly, since visitors who bought nothing add no revenue
The average order value; revenue per visitor here is €1.75
The median revenue per visitor, since buyers are the middle of the data
The conversion rate, expressed in euros instead of percent
